content: .{@-पथः@} .²1 chief road, principal street, high or main road; संतानकाकीर्णमहापथं तत् <ls>Ku. 7. 3</ls>. .²2 the passage into the next world, {%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} death. .²3 <ab>N.</ab> of certain mountain-tops from which devout persons used to throw themselves down to secure entrance into heaven. .²4 an epithet of Śiva. .²5 the long pilgrimage to mount Kedāra. .²6 the way to heaven. .²7 the knowledge of the essence of Śiva acquired in the pilgrimage to Kedāra.
